About

Hey, I’m Mohamed.

Full-stack & AI engineer

I’m a Master’s student in Artificial Intelligence at Saad Dahlab University, Blida 1, with a Bachelor’s in Computer Information Systems.

I build software where a wrong answer costs something: a credit ceiling that has to hold when orders race, a permission boundary an injected prompt must not cross, a safety rating someone acts on.

Each project ships with tests that prove its rules, and documentation of what it does not do yet, usually the more useful half.
